reference_response: Shaped folded case, recessed printed mimic, separate tactile buttons/selector, lower service hatch and visible rear mount/cable support communicate a practical technical control panel.
Pale staff paint, blue-grey frame, zinc rims and restrained colored controls sit naturally with the cool engineering references.
The printed circuit graphic states its water-recovery purpose at640; close detail is required for smaller selector and dial text. Artwork is explicitly static.
Final circular dial removes the prior square-mask artifact; its delta-pressure label is readable in detail. The selector index now agrees with the OFF legend.
Rear pads are clean single surfaces without the prior coplanar standoff-cap pattern; four cleat/standoff connections and cable straps are visible.
remaining_limits: The ordinary640 view does not make all fine labels readable; no game renderer or CRT readability acceptance is implied.
Metadata and sampled sweeps propose controls; no device logic, electrical behavior, telemetric state or actor interaction exists.
Wall mounting height and approach dimensions remain proposals, with no real load, safety or all-species reach certification.
